passages.title: 陽台上的流星雨
passages.text: The news said there would be a meteor shower on Saturday night. Our {1} is in the city, so the sky is usually too bright. But Dad said, "Let's try anyway." At midnight, we turned off all the lights and carried blankets out to the {2}. Mom brought hot {3} for everyone. We waited and waited. My little brother fell asleep, so Dad carried him back to his {4}. Then, at one o'clock, I saw a bright line cross the sky. Then another, and another! I counted twelve meteors and made a wish each time. The next morning, I was very {5} at school, but I didn't care. My brother was upset that he missed it, so we promised to watch the next one together.

blanks.why: apartment「公寓」：我們家的公寓在市區，所以天空太亮。pumpkin（南瓜）、knee（膝蓋）、sock（襪子）都不能住人，也不會「在市區」影響看星星。
carry blankets out to the balcony「把毯子搬到陽台」：在家裡看流星要到戶外的陽台。throat（喉嚨）、cough（咳嗽）、glove（手套）都不是可以去的地方。
hot tea「熱茶」：媽媽幫大家帶熱茶。toe（腳趾）、fever（發燒）、belt（皮帶）都不能「熱熱地端給大家」。
carry him back to his bedroom「抱他回臥室」：弟弟睡著了。cookie、lip、coin 都不是睡覺的房間。
be tired「疲倦」：半夜才睡，隔天上課很累。spicy（辣的）、yummy（好吃的）、crispy（酥脆的）都是形容食物，不能形容人的狀態。

passages.zh: 新聞說星期六晚上會有流星雨。我們家的公寓在市區，天空通常太亮了。但爸爸說：「還是試試看吧。」半夜時，我們關掉所有的燈，把毯子搬到陽台上。媽媽幫大家端來熱茶。我們等了又等，弟弟睡著了，爸爸就把他抱回他的臥室。接著，一點的時候，我看見一道亮光劃過天空，然後又一道、再一道！我數到十二顆流星，每看到一顆就許一次願。隔天早上我在學校非常累，但我一點也不在意。弟弟因為錯過了而很不高興，所以我們約好下一次要一起看。

passages.title: 半夜的滴答聲
passages.text: Last Friday night, I woke up at two o'clock. I heard a strange sound from the {1}: drip, drip, drip. I was too {2} to get out of bed. Was it a ghost? I hid under my blanket and called my brother in the next {3}. "Ben, wake up! Something is in the bathroom!" Ben came over with a flashlight. Together we opened the door slowly. There was no ghost, only the old faucet. Water was falling into the sink, one drop at a time. Ben turned it off and laughed. "Your ghost is just a leaky faucet." The next morning, Dad fixed it. Then he walked into the {4} and found another leak under the sink there. "Our {5} is old," he said, "but at least it has no ghosts."

blanks.why: bathroom「浴室」：滴水聲從浴室傳來，後文也說是水龍頭漏水。pumpkin、wallet、sneaker 都不會是聲音傳來的地方，後面也說要「打開門」進去。
too nervous to…「緊張得不敢…」：以為有鬼，緊張到不敢下床。yummy、spicy、crispy 都是形容食物的字，不能形容人的心情。
the next bedroom「隔壁的臥室」：哥哥睡在隔壁房間。cookie、spoon、jacket 都不能住人。
walk into the kitchen「走進廚房」，廚房的水槽下面也漏水。knee、candy、belt 都不能走進去。
Our apartment is old「我們的公寓很舊」，所以到處漏水。tooth、grape、cap 不會「沒有鬼」，也不能說是我們住的地方。

passages.zh: 上星期五晚上，我在兩點醒來，聽見浴室傳來奇怪的聲音：滴、滴、滴。我緊張得不敢下床。是鬼嗎？我躲在被子裡，叫隔壁房間的哥哥：「Ben，快起來！浴室裡有東西！」Ben 拿著手電筒過來，我們一起慢慢打開門。那裡沒有鬼，只有那個舊水龍頭，水一滴一滴地落進洗手台。Ben 把水龍頭關緊，笑著說：「你的鬼只是一個漏水的水龍頭。」第二天早上，爸爸把它修好了。接著他走進廚房，發現那裡的水槽下面也在漏水。「我們的公寓很舊，」他說，「但至少沒有鬼。」

passages.title: 鏡子上的霧氣留言
passages.text: My older sister Amy is in senior high, and she is always busy. We live in the same {1}, but we hardly talk. One morning, after her shower, I went into the {2} and saw words on the foggy mirror: "Good luck on your test!" I smiled. The next day, I wrote back on the mirror after my shower: "Thanks! Don't forget to eat {3}." Soon, the mirror became our secret message board. We wrote jokes and drew funny faces. When she was {4} about her speech contest, I wrote, "You can do it!" One evening, Mom saw the messages and laughed. "So that's why you two stay in there so long," she said. Now Amy and I talk more, even outside the bathroom. Sometimes we cook noodles together in the {5} late at night.

blanks.why: live in the same apartment「住在同一間公寓」。lemon、knee、sock 都不能住人。
go into the bathroom「走進浴室」：姐姐剛洗完澡，鏡子起霧。cookie、glove、throat 都不能走進去，也沒有鏡子。
eat breakfast「吃早餐」。cough（咳嗽）、belt（皮帶）、toe（腳趾）都不能吃。
be nervous about…「對…感到緊張」：演講比賽前很緊張，所以我寫字鼓勵她。spicy、yummy、crispy 都是形容食物的字。
cook noodles in the kitchen「在廚房煮麵」。throat、candy、sock 都不是煮東西的地方。

passages.zh: 我姐姐 Amy 讀高中，總是很忙。我們住在同一間公寓，卻幾乎不說話。有一天早上她洗完澡後，我走進浴室，看見起霧的鏡子上寫著：「考試加油！」我笑了。隔天我洗完澡，也在鏡子上回她：「謝謝！別忘了吃早餐。」很快地，這面鏡子就成了我們的祕密留言板。我們寫笑話、畫鬼臉。她為了演講比賽緊張的時候，我寫：「你一定做得到！」有一天晚上，媽媽看到這些留言笑了：「原來這就是你們兩個在裡面待那麼久的原因。」現在我和 Amy 話變多了，在浴室外面也是。有時候我們深夜還會一起在廚房煮麵。

passages.title: 飛到樓下的制服
passages.text: Last Monday was very windy. In the morning, I hung my school uniform on the {1} to dry. When I came home, it was gone! I looked down and saw it in a tree in front of our {2} building. I ran downstairs, but I couldn't reach it. An old man from the second floor saw me. He came out with a long stick and helped me get it down. "The wind up on the eighth floor is strong," he said. "Use more clothespins next time." To thank him, Mom and I made {3} in our {4} that evening and took a plate to his door. He was very {5} and invited us in for tea. Now he is our good friend, and he always says, "Check the weather before you hang your clothes!"

blanks.why: hang … on the balcony to dry「掛在陽台晾乾」。tomato、cough、wallet 都不是晾衣服的地方。
apartment building「公寓大樓」：制服掉到大樓前面的樹上。knee、cookie、glove 都不能和 building 組成大樓。
make dumplings「包水餃」，後面說端一盤去送他。coughs、socks、fevers 都不能做成一盤食物送人。
in our kitchen「在我們家廚房」做水餃。throat、lip、cap 都不是做菜的地方。
be surprised「感到驚訝」：鄰居沒想到會收到水餃。spicy、juicy、crispy 都是形容食物，不能形容人。

passages.zh: 上星期一風很大。早上我把學校制服掛在陽台上晾乾，回家時它卻不見了！我往下看，發現它掛在我們公寓大樓前面的樹上。我跑下樓，可是搆不到。住二樓的一位老爺爺看到了，拿著一根長棍子出來，幫我把制服弄下來。「八樓上面的風很強，」他說，「下次多用幾個曬衣夾。」為了謝謝他，那天晚上我和媽媽在家裡廚房包了水餃，端一盤送到他家門口。他非常驚訝，請我們進去喝茶。現在他是我們的好朋友，他總是說：「晾衣服之前要先看天氣！」

passages.title: 陽台上的鴿子窩
passages.text: One spring morning, Mom went out to the {1} to water her plants. She saw two pigeons building a nest in an empty flower pot. She wanted to move it, but I said, "Please let them stay!" A week later, there were two small white eggs. Every day after school, I watched quietly through the window of my {2}. The parents took turns sitting on the eggs. Then the babies came out. They were pink and ugly, but they grew fast. We didn't dry our clothes outside for a month, so we hung them in the {3} instead. Dad complained a little, but he also took many photos. One day, the young birds flew away. I was a little {4}. The {5} felt so quiet without them. But the next spring, the pigeons came back to the same pot!

blanks.why: go out to the balcony「到陽台去」澆花，鴿子在陽台的花盆裡築巢。candy、sock、tooth 都不是可以走出去澆花的地方。
the window of my bedroom「我臥室的窗戶」：從房間窗戶偷看鴿子。soup、knee、belt 都沒有窗戶。
hang them in the bathroom「把衣服晾在浴室」：陽台被鴿子占用，只好改晾在室內。mango、lip、coin 都不能晾衣服。
be sad「難過」：小鴿子飛走了，有點捨不得。spicy、juicy、crispy 都是形容食物的字。
The apartment felt quiet「公寓（家裡）變得好安靜」。throat、cookie、glove 都不能形容成少了鴿子後的家。

passages.zh: 一個春天的早上，媽媽到陽台澆花，看見兩隻鴿子正在一個空花盆裡築巢。她想把巢移走，但我說：「拜託讓牠們留下來！」一個星期後，巢裡出現兩顆小小的白蛋。每天放學後，我都從臥室的窗戶靜靜地看。鴿子爸媽輪流孵蛋，接著小鴿子出生了。牠們粉紅色的，長得有點醜，但長得很快。那一個月我們都沒在外面晾衣服，改把衣服晾在浴室裡。爸爸抱怨了一下，但也拍了很多照片。有一天，小鴿子飛走了，我有點難過，少了牠們，家裡變得好安靜。不過隔年春天，那對鴿子又回到同一個花盆來了！

passages.title: 浴室歌手一家人
passages.text: Everyone in my family sings in the {1}. Dad sings old Taiwanese songs in the shower. Mom sings pop songs while she brushes her {2}. My sister even practices for her school concert there because her voice sounds so loud and clear. Our {3} is small, so the neighbors can hear everything. One day, Mrs. Lin from next door knocked on our door. I was {4} that she wanted to complain. Instead, she said, "Your family sings so well! Our building is having a talent show next month. Will you join?" So now we practice together every night in the {5} while Mom cooks dinner. We call ourselves "The Shower Singers."

blanks.why: sing in the bathroom「在浴室唱歌」，下一句說爸爸邊洗澡邊唱。pork、wallet、toe 都不是可以在裡面唱歌的地方。
brush one's teeth「刷牙」是固定說法。coins、lemons、candies 都不能用來說「刷」。
Our apartment is small「我們的公寓很小」，所以鄰居都聽得到。steak、knee、glove 都不是住的地方。
be worried that…「擔心…」：怕鄰居是來抱怨的。yummy、spicy、crispy 都是形容食物的字。
in the kitchen while Mom cooks「在廚房，媽媽一邊煮晚餐」。cough、candy、shoulder 都不是煮飯的地方。

passages.zh: 我們家每個人都會在浴室唱歌。爸爸洗澡時唱台語老歌，媽媽刷牙時唱流行歌，我姐姐甚至在那裡練習學校音樂會要唱的歌，因為在浴室裡她的聲音聽起來又大又清楚。我們的公寓很小，鄰居什麼都聽得到。有一天，隔壁的林太太來敲我們家的門，我很擔心她是來抱怨的。沒想到她說：「你們一家人唱得真好！我們大樓下個月要辦才藝表演，你們要不要參加？」所以現在我們每天晚上都在廚房一起練唱，媽媽就一邊煮晚餐。我們給自己取名叫「浴室歌手」。

passages.title: 從水管跑出來的青蛙
passages.text: After a heavy rain, I went into the {1} to take a shower. Suddenly, something green jumped out of the drain. It was a frog! I screamed and ran into the {2}. Mom was cooking {3} for dinner. "What's wrong?" she asked. "There's a frog in the bathroom!" Dad laughed. "It must have come up the pipe," he said. "Our {4} is on the first floor, near the park." He caught the frog gently with a towel. Then he carried it out to the {5} and let it jump into the bushes below. My heart was still beating fast, but I also felt a little sorry for the frog. It was just looking for a dry place after the storm, like all of us.

blanks.why: go into the bathroom to take a shower「進浴室洗澡」。steak、tooth、coin 都不能走進去洗澡。
run into the kitchen「跑進廚房」，媽媽正在煮晚餐。knee、candy、belt 都不是可以跑進去的地方。
cook soup「煮湯」當晚餐。cough（咳嗽）、fever（發燒）、sock（襪子）都不能煮來吃。
Our apartment is on the first floor「我們的公寓在一樓」，所以青蛙能從水管爬上來。lip、cookie、glove 都不能說在一樓、靠近公園。
carry it out to the balcony「把牠帶到陽台」，再讓牠跳進下面的樹叢。throat、banana、cap 都不是可以走出去的地方。

passages.zh: 一場大雨過後，我走進浴室要洗澡，突然有個綠色的東西從排水孔跳出來，是一隻青蛙！我尖叫著跑進廚房。媽媽正在煮晚餐要喝的湯。「怎麼了？」她問。「浴室裡有青蛙！」爸爸笑著說：「牠一定是從水管爬上來的。我們的公寓在一樓，又靠近公園。」他用毛巾輕輕地抓住青蛙，把牠帶到陽台，讓牠跳進下面的樹叢裡。我的心還跳得很快，但也有點同情那隻青蛙。暴風雨過後，牠只是想找個乾燥的地方，就像我們大家一樣。

passages.title: 阿公的陽台早餐
passages.text: Every Sunday morning, Grandpa eats {1} on his {2}. He says the morning air is fresh, and he can watch the city wake up. I often stay at his place on Saturday night, so I join him. He makes soy milk and egg pancakes in his small {3}, and I carry the plates outside. We sit on two wooden chairs and look at the mountains far away. Grandpa tells me stories about his childhood in the countryside. After we eat, I wash the dishes, and he waters his plants. Then he takes a short nap in his {4}, and I go home. Breakfast at Grandpa's {5} is my favorite part of the week.

blanks.why: eat breakfast「吃早餐」。knee、sock、fever 都不能吃。
on his balcony「在他的陽台上」：可以呼吸新鮮空氣、看城市醒來。noodle、cough、belt 都不是可以坐著吃早餐的地方。
in his small kitchen「在他小小的廚房」做豆漿和蛋餅。throat、coin、cap 都不是做菜的地方。
take a nap in his bedroom「在臥室小睡」。soup、toe、glove 都不能在裡面睡覺。
at Grandpa's apartment「在阿公的公寓（家）」。lip、candy、mango 都不能表示阿公住的地方。

passages.zh: 每個星期天早上，阿公都在他的陽台上吃早餐。他說早上的空氣很新鮮，還可以看著城市慢慢醒來。我星期六晚上常常住在他家，所以會陪他一起吃。他在小小的廚房裡做豆漿和蛋餅，我把盤子端出去。我們坐在兩張木頭椅子上，看著遠方的山。阿公跟我說他小時候在鄉下的故事。吃完後，我洗碗，他澆花。接著他去臥室睡個午覺，我就回家了。在阿公家吃早餐，是我一星期裡最喜歡的時光。

passages.title: 電梯維修的星期六
passages.text: Our {1} is on the ninth floor. Last Saturday, a sign in the elevator said: "No elevator today. Repair work from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m." Mom had to go to the {2} that morning, so I went with her. Coming back, we carried six heavy bags up nine floors. My legs hurt, and my {3} were sore. When we finally got home, Dad handed us cold juice from the {4}. Then Mom said, "Oh no. I left the eggs in the car." Everyone looked at me. So I walked down nine floors and up again. That night, I fell asleep in my {5} at eight o'clock. The next morning, the elevator worked again. I was so happy that I almost hugged it.

blanks.why: Our apartment is on the ninth floor「我們的公寓在九樓」。lemon、toe、sock 都不能說住在九樓。
go to the supermarket「去超市」，回來時提了很多袋東西。fever、throat、knee 都不是可以去購物的地方。
my shoulders were sore「肩膀痠痛」：提重物爬樓梯。coughs、lemons、cookies 都不是身體部位，不能說痠痛。
cold juice from the kitchen「從廚房拿來的冰果汁」。tooth、candy、glove 裡面拿不出果汁。
fall asleep in my bedroom「在臥室睡著」：太累了，八點就睡。soup、cap、knee 都不能在裡面睡覺。

passages.zh: 我們的公寓在九樓。上星期六，電梯裡貼了一張告示：「今日電梯停用，上午九點到下午六點維修。」那天早上媽媽要去超市，我就跟她一起去。回來時，我們提著六大袋東西爬了九層樓。我的腿好痛，肩膀也很痠。我們終於到家後，爸爸從廚房拿冰果汁給我們。接著媽媽說：「糟了，我把蛋忘在車上了。」大家都看著我。於是我又走下九樓，再爬上來。那天晚上，我八點就在房間睡著了。隔天早上電梯恢復正常，我開心到差點去抱它。

passages.title: 會換房間的公寓
passages.text: Our new {1} is a little strange. On the first night, I walked out of my {2} to get a glass of water. But when I opened the kitchen door, I was standing in the {3}! The next morning, Dad went to brush his teeth. Instead, he found himself in the {4} with a toothbrush in his hand. We soon learned that the rooms moved every night. My little brother loved it. "It's like a game!" he said. Mom was not so happy. One morning, she wanted to hang the clothes outside, but the {5} door opened into my brother's room. Finally, we put a sign on every door: "Please stay where you are. Thank you!" Since then, the rooms have stopped moving. Maybe our apartment just wanted us to be polite.

blanks.why: Our new apartment「我們的新公寓」，後文說房間會移動。pumpkin、knee、sock 都不會有房間。
walk out of my bedroom「走出我的臥室」去拿水。cookie、lip、belt 都不能從裡面走出來。
stand in the bathroom「站在浴室裡」：本來要開廚房的門，卻到了浴室。steak、throat、coin 都不能站在裡面。
find himself in the kitchen「發現自己在廚房裡」：本來要去刷牙。tooth、candy、glove 都不是房間；tooth 雖然和刷牙有關，但不能「站在牙齒裡」。
the balcony door「通往陽台的門」：媽媽要到外面晾衣服。cough、soup、cap 都不會有門。

passages.zh: 我們的新公寓有點奇怪。第一天晚上，我走出臥室要去倒杯水，可是打開廚房的門，我卻站在浴室裡！隔天早上，爸爸要去刷牙，結果他發現自己拿著牙刷站在廚房裡。我們很快就發現，房間每天晚上都會換位置。弟弟愛死了，他說：「好像在玩遊戲！」媽媽可沒那麼開心。有一天早上她要到外面晾衣服，可是陽台的門一打開卻是弟弟的房間。最後，我們在每扇門上都貼了一張紙：「請待在原地，謝謝！」從那之後，房間就不再移動了。也許我們的公寓只是希望我們有禮貌一點。
